newsitem.title: CANADA: Manitoba projects C$27 mln 1997/98 budget surplus.
newsitem.headline: Manitoba projects C$27 mln 1997/98 budget surplus.

text.p: Manitoba Finance Minister Eric Stefanson on Friday projected an annual surplus of C$27 million in his budget for fiscal 1997/98 (April-March).
This is the third consecutive annual surplus for the Canadian province.
Manitoba will transfer C$100 million from its Fiscal Stabilization Fund to offset federal reductions in transfer payments, Stefanson said. Otherwise, it would post a C$73 million deficit inl 1997/98.
Manitoba will pay off C$75 million of its debt to bring it under C$13 billion for the first time in five years.
